title: 托福官方套题 06 · 口语

tasks.sample: First, fill the water tank with fresh water.
Place a coffee filter in the slot.
Use the timer to brew before you wake up each morning.
Put your cup on the drip tray before percolation begins.
Select your preferred beverage strength on the control panel.
You can avert disastrous spills and messes by not overfilling the water tank.
For the best possible performance, you will need to clean your coffee machine at least once per month.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for taking the time to speak with me. I’d like to ask you some questions about reading preferences. First, from what you've noticed about the reading habits of those around you, what kinds of things do your classmates or colleagues like to read?
(Interviewer) I see. When you are reading for work, study or fun, do you prefer to read in a quiet place, or do you like to have some background noise? Why?

(Interviewer) Interesting. Next, I’d like to get your opinion. In recent years, there has been a trend towards people choosing e-books over traditional printed books. What do you think of this trend? Give details for your answer.

(Interviewer) Good points. I just have one more question. Some people believe that reading helps develop imagination and creativity, while watching movies mainly provides entertainment. Do you agree with this idea? Or do you think both activities can build useful skills? Please explain your opinion.
